tasks.title: Framework ownership and support contract
tasks.implementation_unit: Define the public SDK versus internal backend boundary in crates/app/tilo-app, ui and the existing service crates; record required/optional capabilities for Linux/macOS/Windows and applicable architectures. Services under crates/system/runtime/media can be framework-owned without moving them into the renderer.
tasks.acceptance: One reviewed capability/host matrix identifies required implementations, optional absence, existing evidence and release status; every backend has an owner; no app must select an OS implementation.

tasks.title: Scoped host service composition
tasks.implementation_unit: Extend ui/src/application.rs::HostContext and ui/src/launch.rs to carry host-selected service clients bound to existing app/workspace/instance permissions and lifetime; integrate native runtime bootstrap in crates/runtime/runtime-portal/src/native.rs.
tasks.acceptance: Two instances cannot access each other's grants; revocation invalidates pending operations; close releases owned work; packaged startup never invokes Cargo; invalid inherited authority is rejected.

tasks.title: SDK surface and no-new-leaks enforcement
tasks.implementation_unit: Curate crates/app/tilo-app/src/lib.rs exports in migration-sized steps; replace backend-named app features with semantic features; add tools/check_app_platform_contract.py beside the existing resource/action checker. Keep native windowing/GPU adapters and upstream patches inside framework dependencies.
tasks.acceptance: Fixture tests reject app OS imports/selection and direct backend dependencies, permit native framework adapters and portable fixture data, and expire exact migrated exceptions; consumer compile tests reject native types through SDK aliases.

tasks.title: Target and feature dependency gates
tasks.implementation_unit: Add target-resolved graph checks and SDK consumer fixtures under crates/app/tilo-app/tests; coordinate .forgejo/workflows/check.yml and lint.yml with native runner configuration.
tasks.acceptance: Minimal SDK consumers exclude unrelated FUSE/DRM/media stacks; semantic browser/media features resolve correct target backends; resolve build-host tools separately; reject framework-to-app edges and native API leaks.

tasks.title: Known folders, locale and time zones
tasks.implementation_unit: Extend ui/src/sysdirs.rs and ui/src/i18n.rs using framework host providers; migrate word-processor/src/i18n.rs and settings input_sources/time_date discovery.
tasks.acceptance: Redirected/localized folders and native language preferences work without POSIX environment requirements; suggestions confer no grant; unknown current zone stays unknown; old IANA identifiers remain compatible.

tasks.title: Private locations and state migration
tasks.implementation_unit: Centralize data/state/config/cache/runtime roots using settings-store, app-state and runtime identity seams; migrate app path resolvers and service defaults inventoried in the register.
tasks.acceptance: Old profiles/history/journals remain discoverable; concurrent upgrade has one winner; no private cwd/shared-temp fallback; per-user/app/workspace isolation and explicit test roots hold on each host.

tasks.title: Host architecture and executable capability selection
tasks.implementation_unit: Consolidate apps/imager/src/host.rs, crates/packaging/install/src/isa.rs and app-registry/src/index.rs around process/native architecture and usable instruction-set observations.
tasks.acceptance: Windows emulation and macOS translated-process fixtures select native architecture correctly; identical usable-feature sets produce identical package selection; unknown is never x86 by default.

tasks.title: Private and durable filesystem primitives
tasks.implementation_unit: Extend crates/system/atomic-file and crates/runtime/runtime-fs native seams with semantic privacy, bounded no-follow reads, held-directory identity, exclusive creation and durable publication; preserve distinct user-key and machine-key policies.
tasks.acceptance: Native Linux/macOS/Windows tests cover owner/ACL, ancestor and leaf links/reparse points, hardlinks, race replacement, create-new contention and post-publication flush failures; missing guarantee refuses before unsafe mutation.

tasks.title: Cross-process locks and process incarnation
tasks.implementation_unit: Unify app-state/accounts leases and repair packaging install recovery, app-catalogue checkpoints, registry moderation and relay requester lifetime observation.
tasks.acceptance: Real concurrent processes cannot recover a live transaction or regress checkpoints; crash releases locks; PID reuse is rejected; unknown observation cannot mean dead; process-local mutex is never accepted as cross-process protection.

tasks.title: Migrate durable storage consumers
tasks.implementation_unit: Move native storage mechanics from Browser, Tube, PDF, backups, VPN/print, shell identity/nearby transfer, collab persistence and fs subscription/share state into the framework storage APIs. Extract Settings account mutation journal/recovery and its caller compensation as a coherent accounts framework service (additional finding X01).
tasks.acceptance: Existing on-disk fixtures round-trip unchanged; production symlink/ownership/collision/restart tests follow backends; PDF pathname staging retains private publication; browser helper and app share the same cleanup lease protocol.

tasks.title: Owned authenticated local connections
tasks.implementation_unit: Evolve crates/runtime/runtime-portal around owned authenticated connections; keep fd_transport and UnixCapnpClient as backend internals; add host implementations without replacing trusted transport with ambient localhost connections.
tasks.acceptance: Malformed/surplus handles close, transferred authority is adopted once, caller identity and incarnation are verified, framing limits hold, children cannot reuse inherited metadata; alternate hosts require native authentication evidence.

tasks.title: Migrate brokers and typed service clients
tasks.implementation_unit: Move direct sockets/descriptors out of runtime clients, shell runtime host, Files/Agent, model gateway, format host, fs services and compatibility session callers. Retain each existing domain protocol and stronger per-service authorization.
tasks.acceptance: Existing RPC round trips and adversarial peer tests pass; endpoint permission failure prevents startup; same-user identity alone cannot substitute for a certified launcher/workspace; portable clients expose no raw descriptor.

tasks.title: Control and session activity transport

tasks.title: Managed process trees and tools

tasks.acceptance: Controlled descendant helper proves timeout, output limit, cancellation and abrupt-owner-death guarantees separately; pipes unblock, children reap, secrets stay off argv, unrelated processes survive; unavailable required lifetime protection refuses.

tasks.acceptance: Same terminal app/emulation drives native resize/read/write/exit; mandatory confined routes never fall back to ambient shell; macOS lacks Linux namespace support unless actually implemented; service and trusted hosted modes stay distinct.

tasks.title: Application discovery, launch and semantic shortcuts

tasks.title: Trash and owned drag artifacts

tasks.title: Credential custody and scoped secrets

tasks.title: Host trust and SSH identity discovery

tasks.title: Read-only system observations
tasks.implementation_unit: Move Settings facts/security/users, Monitor sampling/identity, Logs journal reader and shared network/power/free-space observations into services; retain sysinfo and bounded Linux parsers.
tasks.acceptance: Unavailable differs from false/empty; PID reuse blocks signaling; optional fd counts can be unknown; hardware memory is not invented; hydration/compute policy uses unknown conservatively; real host probes have native fixtures/integration evidence.

tasks.title: Hardware and desktop service providers

tasks.title: Firewall and VPN operations
